name: crack-prompt-pilot
_comment: Preparation only. DO NOT execute until crack_wall labels + verified negatives exist in eval/benchmark_v1.json.
commands: python live/sweep_sam31.py photo_Sample/crack_wall.jpeg photo_Sample/images.jpeg photo_Sample/img5.jpeg photo_Sample/outlier1.jpeg --phrase "crack in wall" --phrase "wall crack" --phrase "cracked wall" --phrase "crack" --phrase "plaster crack" --confirm-live --overlays --parser-wheel <wheel>
success_rule: A variant wins only if, on the same labelled set, it raises recall at non-worse precision AND its overlay detections visually correspond to real crack traces. More boxes alone is not better.
limitations: One positive image: preliminary evidence only, no generalization claim.
Box IoU at 0.5 is harsh on thin diagonal traces; inspect near-misses manually (see C-05).
Mask IoU reported only if ground-truth masks are drawn; none exist yet.
Spalling detections count as crack false positives unless discounted per the annotation guide (see C-11).
